subject: MAP: milestone ownership, legal checklist & targeted go-live
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa.torres@keplerhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (ownership + dates)

Hi Alyssa — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

Key goals you reiterated:
- Reduce inference latency for triage workflows to under 150ms P50
- Avoid ePHI leaving Kepler tenant; need private deployment or VPC
- Hit unit-cost target for peak loads during business hours

Action items I promised to share: the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached, Kepler_MAP_v2.xlsx) with milestones, proposed owners, and dependencies. High level:
1) Procurement & contract: legal redlines and PO target — due 2026-08-12 (Owner: Kepler Legal)
2) Security review & evidence: SOC 2 artifacts + architecture diagram — due 2026-08-05 (Owner: Kepler SecOps)
3) Private deployment prep: infra checklist and blueprint — due 2026-08-19 (Owner: Redwood Infra)
4) Pilot (3-week): validation on sample workloads, perf targets, and cost telemetry — start 2026-08-23, target complete 2026-09-13 (Owners: Kepler Eng + Redwood SRE)
5) Production go-live: target 2026-09-20 (Contingent on pilot pass + PO)

A few clarifying questions so we can lock dates in MAP:
- Who will be the internal approver for the PO? (I can add to procurement line item)
- Is Kepler able to start the security questionnaire this week? we can prioritize SOC 2 evidence you need from us.

I also attached a short SOW draft to give procurement a sense of charges and timing.

Next steps: please take a look at the MAP and let me know any edits to responsibilities or dates. If that looks good, we can convert this to a final MAP and route for signatures.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0149

Attachment: Kepler_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: milestones, risks, owners)

Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (ownership + dates)

Thanks Rachel — useful summary. Quick answers:
- PO approver will be Danielle Price (VP, Finance). I’ve cc'd her here.
- SecOps can start the questionnaire; I’ll route internally today, expect a first pass by EOD Thu 2026-08-05.

A couple of edits to the MAP:
- For "Private deployment prep" we need a line item for network peering + IP allowlist configuration (Owner: Kepler NetOps). Can you add that?
- Pilot validation: can we add an explicit success criterion: P50 latency <200ms and 99th percentile token cost within 10% of Redwood's estimate?

Also, procurement asked whether Redwood can accept a standard NetTerms-45 and whether we offer an initial pilot discounted rate for the 3-week trial.

If you update the MAP with the small changes I’ll push for internal alignment and get Danielle to confirm the PO timeline.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Torres
Product Director | Kepler Health
alyssa.torres@keplerhealth.com
